results.title: Alfred Woyome files nomination to contest NDC National Vice Chairmanship
results.content: Businessman and National Democratic Congress (NDC) member, Alfred Agbesi Woyome, has filed his nomination to contest the position of National Vice Chairperson of the party.

results.title: Seven companies shortlisted for Keta Port development – Mahama
results.content: President John Mahama has announced that seven companies have been shortlisted for the development of the Keta Port in the Volta Region.

results.title: Naa Seidu Tungbani Salinbille II outdoored as Dorimon chief after four-year dispute
results.content: Naa Seidu Tungbani Salinbille II has been outdoored as the new chief of Dorimon in the Wa West District of the Upper West Region.

results.title: Lawra Municipal Assembly outlines 2027 development priorities, commits to education and security
results.content: The Lawra Municipal Assembly has held its third ordinary meeting, bringing together key stakeholders to assess the municipality's progress and outline its development priorities for 2027.

results.title: WPL 2026/27: Hasaacas Ladies come from behind to beat Epiphany Warriors
results.content: Hasaacas came from a goal down to claim all three points at the Madina Astro Turf, securing a 2-1 victory over the Katamanso-based side.

results.title: Exim Bank to commence a 200-acre textile and garment industrial hub for Weta, targeting 3,000 jobs – Mahama
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has announced plans to establish a light industrial area dedicated to textile and garment manufacturing at Weta in the Volta Region through the Ghana Export-Import Bank (Ghana EXIM Bank).

results.title: Bono East Regional Minister pledges gov’t support for Kintampo North development at Pedia Festival
results.content: The Bono East Regional Minister, Francis Owusu Antwi, joined the Member of Parliament for Kintampo North, Joseph Kwame Kumah (Jakala), and the Municipal Chief Executive, Isaac Donkor, to celebrate this year's Pedia (Yam) Festival with the Mo Paramount Chief, Nana Kwaku Danquah III, and Nananom of the Mo Traditional Council.

results.title: NPP-USA elections: Calls for in-person voting and clear timetable ahead of Nov. 30 deadline
results.content: A member of the New Patriotic Party’s United States branch, Opoku Boateng, has called for in-person voting and an immediate election timetable as the November 30 deadline for outstanding party polls approaches.

results.title: UK cannot ‘cherry pick’ EU single market deal, Barnier tells BBC
results.content: The EU's former Brexit negotiator has warned that the UK cannot "cherry pick" which elements of the single market to which it subscribes, after Andy Burnham said he wanted to explore closer economic ties with Europe.

results.title: Pope in ‘pretty good health’ as he starts Latin America tour
results.content: Pope Leo XIV has told reporters travelling with him to Latin America he is "in pretty good health", in his first comments on his condition since having surgery for lung cancer.

results.title: Police arrest 57-year-old man over viral shoplifting videos
results.content: The Eastern Regional Police Command has arrested a 57-year-old man suspected of being behind a series of shoplifting incidents captured in videos that recently went viral on TikTok and other social media platforms.

results.title: Paraguay’s president impeached and under house arrest after bank collapse
results.content: Paraguay's President Santiago Peña has been impeached and placed under house arrest after a bank collapse triggered a crisis that left more than half of the country's population without access to their accounts.

results.title: Emotional scenes as family, colleagues bid farewell to Bampoe-Addo twin brothers
results.content: Family members, friends, colleagues, and sympathisers have gathered at the forecourt of the State House in Accra for the final funeral rites of twin brothers, Sidney Nii Oko Bampoe-Addo and Dr Isaac Akuetteh Bampoe-Addo.

results.title: Russian strikes wound nine and damage Ukraine’s power network ahead of talks
results.content: Overnight drone and ballistic missile attacks damaged Ukrainian energy infrastructure, President Volodymyr Zelenskyhas said, causing blackouts and disrupting water supplies.

results.title: ‘Why bring the waste to us?’ – Annoh-Dompreh demands answers over Nsawam plan
results.content: The Minority Chief Whip and MP for Nsawam-Adoagyiri, Frank Annoh-Dompreh, has demanded an explanation for a reported government plan to move waste from Agbogbloshie to a facility in the Nsawam area.

results.title: Nana B urges Mahama to act on Obuasi SHS headmaster abuse allegations
results.content: The National Second Vice Chairman of the New Patriotic Party (NPP) has called on President John Dramani Mahama to intervene in the reported abuse involving the Headmaster of Obuasi Senior High School (SHS), warning against any attempt to shield the suspect because of his political affiliation.

results.title: Asiedu Nketiah elected inaugural chair of African Political Parties Initiative
results.content: The National Democratic Congress (NDC) Chairman, Johnson Asiedu Nketiah has been elected the inaugural Chair of the African Political Parties Initiative (APPI), placing him at the head of a new continental platform for political parties. He was nominated by an interim committee established by APPI and was unanimously approved by members of the Political Parties in Africa at the African Political Parties Summit 2026 in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, on Saturday, November 7, where the initiative's inaugural leadership was constituted.

results.title: German Ambassador to Ghana celebrates Ibrahim Mahama’s Arnold Bode Prize, highlights longstanding Germany ties
results.content: German Ambassador to Ghana, Frederik Landshöft, has hosted a reception in Accra to celebrate Ghanaian artist Ibrahim Mahama following his receipt of the 2026 Arnold Bode Prize, one of Germany’s prestigious contemporary art awards. The reception, held earlier this week at the Ambassador’s residence, brought together guests to recognise Mr Mahama’s contribution to contemporary art […]

results.title: Mahama, Queen Máxima discuss digital financial services, future of susu system
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has discussed plans to expand digital financial services and improve access to affordable credit and insurance with Queen Máxima of the Netherlands, the United Nations Secretary-General’s Special Advocate for Financial Health.

results.title: Hope is a commodity political parties must sell
results.content: Hope is one of the most important commodities political parties must sell. Not through slogans, campaign promises or carefully choreographed speeches, but through the visible possibility of a better future. People are more willing to endure hardship, make sacrifices and invest their energies when they believe their efforts will lead somewhere. They will support difficult reforms when they can see the destination. They will make extraordinary contributions when they believe success is attainable.

results.title: New Economy to push Ghana towards investment grade – Dr. Ato Forson
results.content: This is to lower the country’s borrowing costs and help Ghanaian businesses raise long-term financing, Finance Minister Dr. Cassiel Ato Forson has said.

results.title: Asiedu Nketiah urges African parties to look beyond elections, build institutions for 2040
results.content: National Democratic Congress (NDC) Chairman Johnson Asiedu Nketiah has called on African political parties to strengthen their institutional capacity and prepare leaders capable of addressing the continent’s long-term development challenges. He said political parties must look beyond winning elections and invest in the knowledge, expertise and structures needed to govern effectively. Mr Asiedu Nketiah made the call in an acceptance address after assuming office as inaugural Chair of the African Political Parties Initiative (APPI) at the African Political Parties Summit 2026 in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, on Saturday, November 7.

results.title: ECG to begin nationwide revenue mobilisation exercise, warns customers with arrears of disconnection
results.content: The Electricity Company of Ghana (ECG) will begin a nationwide Mass Revenue Mobilisation Exercise on Monday, November 9, to recover outstanding electricity bills from customers. The exercise will run until Friday, November 27, 2026, and will cover all categories of customers with arrears, including residential, commercial and industrial customers, as well as Ministries, Departments and Agencies (MDAs).

results.title: MSK Zilina Africa, Soccer Engineers head to Spain for ARG Nerja Cup
results.content: Ghanaian lower-division sides MSK Zilina Africa and Soccer Engineers have departed the country to participate in the ARG Nerja Cup 2026 in Nerja, Málaga, Spain.

results.title: Drug bust: Beirut officials’ accounts raise questions about NACOC’s cocaine ‘controlled delivery’ claim – Bright Simons
results.content: The Honorary Vice President of IMANI Africa, Bright Simons, has questioned the claim by the Narcotics Control Commission (NACOC) that the movement of a 46.7kg consignment of suspected cocaine from Accra to Beirut was part of a controlled delivery operation.

results.title: Accra Airport concourse project linking Terminals 2 and 3 reaches 20% completion – Felix Kwakye Ofosu
results.content: Government Spokesperson Felix Kwakye Ofosu says construction of the concourse linking Terminals 2 and 3 at the Kotoka International Airport has reached 20 per cent completion.
